method: Full navigations with browser cache enabled; requested visible tab but preview reported visible=false. Representative home heading was already present and Performance paint entries empty. No passive pre-load readiness timestamp captured; no estimates used. Resource count and transferSize are browser Performance entries after the first desktop load, excluding unobservable cross-origin transfer sizes and subject to caching. Console and failed-request counts unavailable per navigation. Phone uses iPhone 12 Pro preset, innerWidth verified 390; document scrollWidth only, no visual inspection. Desktop innerWidth 1280. Signed-in /app/moves: readiness:none followed by browser-side MutationObserver for a move-card link; three samples, ordinary cache, tab reported visible=false and no paint entries. Other signed-in routes received one desktop and one phone navigation; several desktop evaluations caught redirects and their metrics are omitted. Phone checks only document scrollWidth, not visual inspection.

missing_value_reasons.first_content_ms: No paint entries in representative background preview; three usable samples unavailable.
missing_value_reasons.data_ready_ms: Only /app/moves had three observed marker timestamps; other pages lacked three usable samples.
missing_value_reasons.requests: Performance resource entries, not a complete network log.
missing_value_reasons.transferred_kb: Cross-origin and cached transfer sizes have visibility limits; gate bytes omitted.

unvisited: Two real examples of each ID route unavailable: one move in list; no box detail links found. /app/boxes/[boxId] not visited. /share/[token] requires a real share link and was not guessed. Endpoints are not rendered pages. Full visual inspection, menu/dead-end review, three-load timings and per-navigation diagnostics remain incomplete.

rows.notes: Three desktop navigations with passive observer: move-card link appeared at 3146.9, 1164.9, and 1425.3 ms; median 1425.3 ms. Tab reported visible=false; paint entries empty. One phone load; one move available.
